scope: Twenty owned PTY launches with fresh app/data/config directories. First zoom-in, zoom-out, pan-right and pan-left per launch; no physical display claim. OS caches and load uncontrolled. Unlike the hosted observer, this local tool drains output for 200 ms before its first key.

reference.scope: Key write to full image receipt and synchronized update end in an owned PTY; no physical display timing. False adapter prevents agent/account work. OS caches and load uncontrolled.
